description: Address 4 issues from the semantic review: (1) Add More Filters popover for geometry/availability, (2) Document ephemeral favorite as intentional, (3) Add unit tests for CategoryCarousel, LookSwatches, FilterChipBar, (4) Document activeCategory as intentional tech debt.
steps: Add a 'More Filters' button/popover to DesignLibrary.tsx or FilterChipBar.tsx that allows users to set wallGeometry and availability filters via a compact dropdown/popover mechanism.
Add code comment in EnhancedTemplateCard.tsx documenting that the ephemeral favorite state is intentional cosmetic-only behavior.
Create unit tests for CategoryCarousel in __tests__/CategoryCarousel.test.tsx following existing test patterns.
Create unit tests for LookSwatches in __tests__/LookSwatches.test.tsx following existing test patterns.
Create unit tests for FilterChipBar in __tests__/FilterChipBar.test.tsx following existing test patterns.
Add code comment in DesignLibrary.tsx documenting that activeCategory is intentional local state to avoid modifying the store, with a note about future migration.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set wallGeometry and availability filters via the new More Filters UI
Ephemeral favorite state has a documenting comment explaining it is intentional
CategoryCarousel has unit tests covering rendering, click interaction, and keyboard navigation
LookSwatches has unit tests covering rendering, click interaction, and active state
FilterChipBar has unit tests covering chip rendering, removal, and clear all
DesignLibrary.tsx has a code comment about activeCategory being intentional tech debt
All existing and new tests pass
